resources.string: One Hermes server (LLM-4-People/hermes-agent fork) can host multiple isolated profiles under the same HTTPS address.
Enter your profile name to automatically build /p/profile on the same server.
Enter the HTTPS address of your Hermes server.
Use a simple name (letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores, with no path).
The server address already points to another profile.
This passphrase encrypts your access details and unlocks the profile on this device.
